# Start Where We Are Festival

> Start Where We Are (SWWA) Earth Music Festival 2026 is a free, all-ages live-music benefit concert for environmental organizations in Somerville, Massachusetts — minutes from Boston and Cambridge.

## Event details

- **What:** Live music benefit concert for the environment (music + sustainability festival)
- **When:** Wednesday, September 23, 2026, 6:00–10:00 PM (doors 5:00 PM)
- **Where:** Upstairs at Bow, Bow Market, 1 Bow Market Way, Somerville, MA 02143 (Union Square). Indoor venue — rain or shine.
- **Cost:** Free admission; suggested $15 donation. Register: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/start-where-we-are-earth-music-festival-2026-tickets-1998927218119
- **Ages:** All ages
- **Getting there:** Public transportation and nearby parking
- **Proceeds:** Support the artists and give back to environmental organizations
- **Donate:** https://givebutter.com/swwafestival
- **Contact:** startwherewearefestival@gmail.com

## 2026 lineup

- SWWA Collective — https://sofiavillarrealmusic.com/
- Dimitris Terpizis Quartet — https://dimitristerpizis.com/
- Sofia Almeida & Yujin Han Duo — https://www.instagram.com/sofia.almeida.music/
- Rita Valldeperas — https://ritavalldeperas.com/
- Jade Faria — https://www.jadefaria.com.br/
- LAVAGXRL — https://www.instagram.com/lavagxrl/

## What to expect

Live performances from local artists, courtyard fires, eco-friendly vendors and climate organizations, food and drink from Bow Market's award-winning businesses, and ways to sign up, connect and take climate action.

## About the organization

Start Where We Are is a grassroots, volunteer-run festival founded by Boston musician Sofia Villarreal. It celebrates Boston's music scene and partners with local businesses, artists and organizations to support independent artists and environmental causes. Sponsors and partners have included Berklee, BGJI, Bow Market, JGJ, Liberal Arts and Life Alive.
